props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by `asChild`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.

Use this when you need a component to render through a child element while keeping the primitive's props and behavior.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When `true`, prevents the user from selecting this item.

props.name: textValue
props.description:
A plain-text representation of the item contents, used for filtering.
Required when the children are not plain text.

props.name: value
props.description: The value given when this item is selected. Must not be an empty string.
